complexity_scope.guarantee: Per-fixed-instance success at least 2/3; source lower statement gives failure at least 1/3 on a per-algorithm fixed legal instance. No expected-query formulation inferred.
complexity_scope.hidden_constants: Universal constants; Otilde suppresses logarithmic factors including inner accuracy, not arbitrary polynomial dependence.
complexity_scope.oracle: Exact value, complete joint gradient and complete joint Hessian bundle; not one HVP.
complexity_scope.regime: Three r windows, A1>=C for lower bound; retain additive I0 and matching condition against I0+1.
complexity_scope.resource: Charged bundle queries and free transcript computation; no separately priced gradient/Hessian frontier.
complexity_scope.upper_witness_or_lower_coverage: Deterministic upper algorithms; arbitrary measurable randomized adaptive algorithms for the lower bound, including unqueried output and sufficiently large finite dimension.

content.intended_use: Apply the selected paper's joint accuracy, conditioning and Hessian-smoothness frontier.

map: B.1–B.3 give grad E(x)=grad Phi(u_x), envelope gap<=Delta, dual sensitivity<=2sqrt(kappa) and envelope Hessian Lipschitz constant<=8rho(1+kappa)^(3/2).
C.1–C.3 eliminate a primal block of condition number<=3. Reduced dual Hessian is between mu I and 2L I, with Lipschitz constant<=4sqrt(2)rho and a certified simulated oracle.

C.5 and C.7 import external A-HPE convergence and coupled line-search interfaces. C.6,C.8–C.9 certify simulation. D.2 contracts at Otilde(1+min{sqrt(kappa),(rho D/mu)^(2/7)}); warm starts satisfy D_t<=tau_(t-1)+2sqrt(kappa)||x_t-x_(t-1)||.
E.1–E.3 amortize squared/cubic step energies via Holder, yielding A1(1+r^(2/7)), A2(1+r^(1/7)), first-order cap sqrt(kappa)A1, I0 and terminal output refinement.

F.1 imports CDHS hardness with a literal quantifier-order ambiguity. The separate complete quadratic transfer and explicit Hard Family reconstruct the small-r baseline using a distribution before algorithm coins and N+2 hitting positions.

H.10–H.13 use imported internal packet/chamber interfaces H.7–H.9, conditional bad-event bounds and averaging over frames. Their full packet construction and proofs are not read or reconstructed here.
proofs.omitted_details: Literature map, not full reproof. Primary H.7–H.9 and original external [11]–[12] remain imported. Supplemental CDHS base reconstruction does not verify the other frontier branches.
proofs.reading_coverage: Current primary images pp.1,3–8,16–19; original PDF text pp.4–19,33–34. Primary pp.20–32 not fully read.

assumptions: Globally ||grad f(z)-grad f(z')||<=L||z-z'|| and ||H_f(z)-H_f(z')||<=rho||z-z'||. For every x, f(x,.) is mu-strongly concave.

One charged query at arbitrary (x,y) returns exact f, full gradient and full joint Hessian. All measurable computation from returned real numbers/matrices is free, including exact linear algebra and exact minimization of transcript-derived models.
Algorithms may query adaptively and return an unqueried primal point. Randomized coins are instance-independent. Worst case ranges over all finite dimensions.
statement.conclusion: M2det(epsilon)<=Otilde(I0+min{A2(1+r^(1/7)),A1(1+r^(2/7)),sqrt(kappa)A1}). If A1>=C, M2rand(epsilon)>=c A1 Psi_kappa(r). Matching deterministic/randomized leading behavior within logarithmic factors is asserted only when A1 Psi_kappa(r) dominates I0+1. The three leading rates are Delta sqrt(rho) kappa^(3/4) epsilon^(-3/2) for r<=1; Delta rho^(2/7) kappa^(3/7) L^(3/7) epsilon^(-12/7) for 1<=r<=kappa^(7/4); Delta L sqrt(kappa) epsilon^-2 for r>=kappa^(7/4).
statement.objects_and_definitions: f:R^dx x R^dy -> R is C^2; norms are Euclidean and induced operator norms. Phi(x)=max_y f(x,y), y*(x)=argmax_y f(x,y), kappa=L/mu. A1=Delta L epsilon^-2, A2=Delta sqrt(rho) kappa^(3/4) epsilon^(-3/2), r=rho kappa^(3/2) epsilon/L^2, so A2=A1 sqrt(r). Dy0=Ry+kappa sqrt(Delta/L), I0=Otilde(1+min{sqrt(kappa),(rho Dy0/mu)^(2/7)}). Psi_kappa(r)=sqrt(r) for 0<r<=1; r^(2/7) for 1<=r<=kappa^(7/4); sqrt(kappa) for r>=kappa^(7/4).
statement.parameter_domains: L>=mu>0; rho,Delta,epsilon>0; Ry>=0; kappa>=1. Finite dimensions unrestricted in the worst case. Lower bound requires A1>=C. Displayed frontier uses r>0.
statement.quantifiers_and_randomness: Universal c,C>0 exist. The deterministic upper bound holds for every legal instance. If A1>=C, every randomized algorithm with query budget below c A1 Psi_kappa(r) fails with probability at least 1/3 on some deterministic legal instance chosen independently of its realized seed; that instance has Ry=0. Section 3 requires success at least 2/3 on every fixed legal instance.
